correctness.rationale: The two unimodular layer matrices give F=cos(phi1)cos(phi2)-m sin(phi1)sin(phi2)=A cos(u)-B cos(v), B/A=kappa^2. Irrational torus equidistribution applies to the gap indicator because the real-analytic band-edge locus has area zero. Conditioning on v gives an arcsin phase integral; differentiating it yields artanh(kappa)/kappa and the stated odd dilogarithm. Equal phases give 2 asin(kappa)/pi; strict concavity on (0,pi) yields the strict comparison. Coprime rational line-measures converge weakly to Haar measure by Fourier characters, proving the discontinuity. An independent exact symbolic multiplication verified F and determinant 1; infinite-frequency assertions are proven analytically, not numerically.
